brief: Write the limerick Petra shouts up to Tomas as her boat comes alongside on a Thursday. One limerick: five lines, rhyming AABBA, anapestic, three beats in lines 1, 2, and 5 and two in lines 3 and 4. Name Tomas and mention the paraffin. Say nothing about the key. Return only the limerick.
name: verse-limerick
